name: Nikola Petrović
bio: Nikola Petrović's path to motorsport security was unconventional, starting with a background in military police. After serving, he transitioned his skills in risk assessment and logistical planning to private security, eventually finding his niche within racing. Nikola prides himself on being proactive, identifying potential vulnerabilities before they become issues. He's known for his meticulous approach, treating every detail as critical and fostering a culture of vigilance within his security team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly cropped with a slight wave on top.
physical.description: Nikola is of average height with a sturdy build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously jotting down observations.
Has a habit of thoroughly checking fire exits and emergency procedures in every new location.
Insists on a daily team briefing, even if there are no apparent security concerns.
